detaileddescription.para: Single action set that owns all hand-interaction actions AND the palm pose action. Combining them avoids needing a second xrAttachSessionActionSets call, which is only permitted once per session.

briefdescription.para: sub-action paths for left (index 0) and right (index 1) hands.

detaileddescription.para: Used when creating actions with sub-action paths and when querying per-hand action state.

briefdescription.para: One pose action per interaction_pose_type (AIM=0 … POKE=3).

detaileddescription.para: Each action was created with both left and right sub-action paths so that a single action covers both hands; the per-hand state is retrieved by passing the appropriate sub-action path to xrGetActionStatePose / xrLocateSpace.

briefdescription.para: Action spaces indexed as [hand][interaction_pose_type].

detaileddescription.para: Created in init_hand_interaction() via xrCreateActionSpace with the corresponding pose action and sub-action path. Used every frame inside update_hand_interaction() to locate each pose.

briefdescription.para: Float (gesture-strength) actions for AIM (0), GRIP (1), and PINCH (2).

detaileddescription.para: POKE has no value binding in XR_EXT_hand_interaction and is therefore not represented here.

briefdescription.para: Boolean (gesture-ready) actions for AIM (0), GRIP (1), and PINCH (2).

detaileddescription.para: As with value actions, POKE has no ready binding.

briefdescription.para: Palm pose action from XR_EXT_palm_pose, shared across both hands via sub-action paths.

detaileddescription.para: Bindings are suggested against every relevant interaction profile so that a palm pose is available regardless of whether the user is using bare hands or holding controllers.

briefdescription.para: Action spaces for the palm pose, indexed by hand (LEFT=0, RIGHT=1).

detaileddescription.para: Created in init_hand_interaction() once the action and session are ready.

briefdescription.para: Compute the offset between XrTime and CLOCK_MONOTONIC once at session initialization using xrConvertTimespecTimeToTimeKHR.

detaileddescription.para: Populates xr_to_monotonic_offset_ns_ such that: CLOCK_MONOTONIC_ns = XrTime + xr_to_monotonic_offset_ns_
Also computes monotonic_to_system_offset_ns_ such that: system_clock_ns = CLOCK_MONOTONIC_ns + monotonic_to_system_offset_ns_
Both offsets are sent in every combined_pose so the server can convert headset XrTime into Monado time.

briefdescription.para: Initialize the OpenXR hand tracking extension.

detaileddescription.para: Queries for XR_EXT_hand_tracking support and creates hand trackers for both left and right hands.

simplesect.para: true if hand tracking was successfully initialized

briefdescription.para: Clean up hand tracking resources.
Update hand tracking and palm pose data for the current frame.

detaileddescription.para: Locates hand joints at the predicted display time, publishes joint tracking data to "hand_tracking" and extracts palm poses to publish on "palm_poses".

parameterdescription.para: The predicted display time for this frame

briefdescription.para: Initialize the XR_EXT_hand_interaction action set.

detaileddescription.para: Creates actions for aim / grip / pinch / poke poses (and their associated gesture-strength values and readiness flags), suggests bindings against the hand-interaction interaction profile, attaches the action set to the session, and creates the per-hand action spaces used each frame.
Must be called after create_session() and, if hand tracking is used, after init_hand_tracking().

simplesect.para: true if the action set was fully initialized

briefdescription.para: Destroy action spaces and the hand interaction action set.
Sync actions and publish hand interaction poses for the current frame.

detaileddescription.para: Calls xrSyncActions, then for every hand × interaction-pose-type combination: locates the action space, and (for AIM / GRIP / PINCH) reads the gesture-strength value and readiness boolean. Publishes a hand_interaction_poses_pair to "hand_interaction" when at least one pose is valid.
